definitions.explanation: A person who works diligently and tirelessly. A complimentary term for someone who puts in great effort.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{働|はたら}き{者|もの}だ。
うちの{祖母|そぼ}は{昔|むかし}から{働|はたら}き{者|もの}で{有名|ゆうめい}だった。
examples.english: My grandmother was famous for being a hard worker since long ago.

examples.japanese: ミツバチは{自然界|しぜんかい}で{最|もっと}も{知|し}られた{働|はたら}き{者|もの}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Honeybees are said to be the most well-known hard workers in the natural world.

notes:
A positive term. The suffix {者|もの} here means "person characterized by." Can be used for animals as well as people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{働|はたら}き{者|もの}で{知|し}られる (known as a hard worker)
・{大|おお}の{働|はたら}き{者|もの} (a great hard worker)
